title: HotelRoomDataContract
description: Schema definition for hotel_room Custom Post Type and its associated post meta in Mix Hotel.

slug.description: Unique URL slug for the room (e.g., 'bad-girl', 'inferno', 'karma')

title.description: Display title of the room (e.g., 'Room 001 - Bad girl', 'VIP Room 102 - Inferno')

branch_slug.description: Slug of the hotel_branch post that this room belongs to

excerpt.description: Brief description used in card previews and meta tags

content.description: Full description and concept story of the room

price_2h.description: Price for the first 2 hours in VND (e.g., 199000, 300000, 400000)

price_extra.description: Price per additional hour in VND (e.g., 50000, 60000, 80000, 100000)

youtube_id.description: YouTube video ID for room video preview (empty string if none)

featured.description: Whether the room is featured on homepage / highlights

thumb_path.description: Theme-relative path to the primary room thumbnail image

amenities.description: List of room_amenity taxonomy term slugs assigned to the room
